title: Assistant Store Manager Macpac Adelaide
description:
Step into your next move, as an Assistant Store Manager in South Adelaide.

A hands-on leadership role where youâll be front and centre with your team, driving performance, owning your results, and bringing energy to the floor. Perfect for an experienced ASM or a driven Supervisor/Team Leader ready to step up.

With a sharp eye for KPIs, strong planning and accountability, and a passion for people (with a love of the outdoors or visual merchandising is a bonus). All backed by a supportive team, great culture, and endless growth opportunities.

  • Newly created role driven by exciting growth
  • Tuesday to Saturday â enjoy your personal time uninterrupted!
  • Competitive salary with super, weekly pay, and potential bonus opportunities
  • Fantastic discounts across Macpac, BCF, Supercheap Auto and rebel.
  • True job security, powered by Super Retail Groupâs strength and 750+ stores across Australia and New Zealand.

Whatâs in it for you?

Be rewarded with great work-life balance, group wide career and development opportunities along with:

  • Inclusive & Supportive Culture: Join a diverse, inclusive workplace where you can bring your whole self to work and grow your career.
  • Innovation & Recognition: Thrive in a culture that champions innovation, collaboration, and celebrates your contributions through a dedicated recognition platform.
  • Wellbeing Focus: Benefit from wellbeing initiatives, including 24/7 support through the Sonder app.
  • Exclusive Perks: Enjoy corporate rates on travel, fitness, insurance, entertainment, and more, plus great team discounts through our Perks Program.
  • Parental Support: Access generous Parental Leave from day one, supporting both primary and secondary carers.

Who are we?

Macpac is New Zealand's original outdoor brand and have grown to find a home in the Australian market. We've made it our business to show people that life is better when you're outside. We're a socially conscious business, and we operate in a way that is both ethical and sustainable. title: Technical Storekeeper
description:
Job Description

Job Summary

The Technical Storekeeper is responsible for handling and managing the receiving, storage, and processing of incoming and outgoing spare parts and technical supplies at one or more Carnival Corporation owned and operated global destination. This role supports the overall management of inventory levels, ensuring that all materials are accurately accounted for, properly stored, and readily available for technical teams as needed. The Technical Storekeeper monitors stock levels, maintains accurate records, coordinates with procurement for replenishment, and ensures compliance with company policies and safety standards. The position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work collaboratively with maintenance and technical staff to support smooth operational workflows.

  • Inventory Management and Record Keeping
  • Keep accurate records regarding stock counts, requirements, and reporting needs.
  • Review and issue a weekly inventory list of technical spares.
  • Update and maintain system records upon arrival of new parts and tools.
  • Label and maintain all tools, equipment, and spare parts.
  • Audit incoming materials for accurate paperwork and counts.
  • Confirm deliveries against invoices for accuracy of store count.
  • Monitor inventory levels to prevent shortages or overstock situations.
  • Track usage of spare parts to support maintenance planning and budgeting.
  • Ordering and Procurement Support
  • Place requests for all parts necessary for the storeroom for review and approval.
  • Assist with purchasing items and materials as needed.
  • Liaise with staff, management, and vendors to source supplies efficiently.
  • Coordinate with procurement teams to ensure timely delivery of parts.
  • Review vendor quotes and maintain records of supplier transactions.
  • Suggest alternatives for unavailable or discontinued parts.
  • Stores Organization and Receiving
  • Maintain stores in an organized and well-ordered manner.
  • Assist with unloading containers, sorting, counting, and receiving materials.
  • Ensure proper storage, handling, and labeling of all parts and tools.
  • Implement storage systems to maximize space and accessibility.
  • Conduct regular inspections to ensure cleanliness and orderliness of storerooms.
  • Follow safety protocols when handling heavy or hazardous materials.
  • Reporting, Compliance, and Other Duties
  • Create required reports related to inventory, usage, and discrepancies.
  • Uphold environmental policies and procedures in all store operations.
  • Document and report any damaged or defective parts to management.
  • Perform any other duties assigned by management.
  • Support cross-functional teams by providing required spare parts and technical materials.
  • Assist in audits and inspections as needed.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities Needed

  • Ability to adhere to the companyâs standards regarding dress and appearance.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality and data protection standards when handling vendor financial or business documents
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a team-oriented environment as necessary.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to multitask effectively.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with data entry and reporting tools.
  • Detail orientated with a proactive approach to problem solving.
  • Ability to multi-task and think critically
  • Problem-solving and decision-making abilities
  • Strong planning and coordination skills, especially in handling multiple priorities under tight deadlines.
  • Must be physically fit.
  • Ability to work in an outdoor environment as needed.
  • May need to stand for long periods of time.
  • May be requested to work a shift schedule while at any of the destinations.
  • Knowledge: Understanding of workplace policies and procedures / Familiarity with team collaboration tools and techniques.
  • Skills: Strong time management and organizational skills
  • Abilities: Ability to maintain reliable and consistent attendance / Capacity to be punctual and meet deadlines / Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and work as part of a team / Demonstrated professionalism in all interactions and tasks.

HESS Responsibilities

  • Adhere to all company policies, procedures, and guidelines related to health, safety, environmental protection, and security.
  • Take all necessary precautions, use personal protective equipment (PPE), safety devices, and tools correctly and consistently, as required by the nature of the work.
  • Promptly report any unsafe conditions, incidents, or environmental concerns to the appropriate supervisor or HESS representative.
  • Take reasonable care for your own health and safety, as well as that of colleagues and others who may be affected by your actions.
  • Actively participate in HESS trainings and initiatives that promote a safe, secure, and environmentally sustainable workplace.
  • Cooperate fully with company efforts to maintain compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
  • Seek opportunities to improve safety and environmental performance in daily tasks.

Essential/Minimum Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or GED ; equivalent experience is required; additional education in Hospitality or a related field is a plus
  • Current Health Certificate

Essential Experience Required

  • A minimum of two (2) years relevant work experience in a technical role
  • Ability to lift at least 50 pounds.
  • Ability to create reports and documentation skills.
  • Analytical and Numerate Skills
  • Strong interpersonal, problem solving, conflict resolution and communication skills.
  • Proficient in English
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office
  • Working knowledge of: Swimming hazards; Beach Hazards; Pool hazards Lifeguard training techniques
  • First aid and Cardio-pulmonary Resuscitation (CPR)
  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
  • All island employees must be physically able to participate in emergency lifesaving procedures and drills. Full use/range of motion of arms and legs as well as full visual, verbal and hearing abilities are required to receive and give instructions in the event of an emergency.

title: Java Developer
description:
About the Role

We are an early-stage, venture-backed AI infrastructure company building production-ready Kubernetes-based systems for GPU-intensive workloads. Our platform helps companies go from bare metal to fully operational AI clusters in days, and we're looking for a Java Developer to join our small, high-impact engineering team.

What You'll Do

  • Understand customer requirements and translate them into robust, scalable Java-based solutions.

  • Design, develop, and maintain backend services and infrastructure tooling that supports our distributed systems platform.

  • Collaborate closely with product and infrastructure engineers to deliver features end-to-end.

  • Contribute to the reliability and performance of systems handling AI inference pipelines, distributed training, storage orchestration, and GPU scheduling workloads.

  • Participate in code reviews, architectural discussions, and continuous improvement of engineering practices.

What We're Looking For

  • Required:

    • Solid hands-on experience with Java development and the JVM ecosystem.

    • Familiarity with distributed systems concepts and cloud-native environments.

    • Experience working with or around Kubernetes, containerization (Docker), or related infrastructure tooling.

    • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, early-stage environment.

    • Clear communication skills â we are a small team and direct collaboration matters.

  • Nice to have:

    • Experience with GitOps workflows or tools (e.g., Flux, ArgoCD).

    • Exposure to GPU scheduling, ML infrastructure, or high-performance computing environments.

    • Familiarity with open-source contribution practices.

    • Experience in a startup or early-stage company setting.

Compensation & Benefits

Compensation details were not provided for this role. This is a full-time position at an early-stage, VC-backed company where equity participation is typical. Details will be discussed during the interview process.

Location

This role is based in Los Angeles, CA, USA. The company also has a presence in San Francisco, CA.

Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

title: Lead Product Manager, B2B Trade Platform
description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

About this role

We're hiring a Director Product Management to own a core product area end to end. This is a hands-on leadership role: you'll set direction and ship it yourself, reporting directly to the founder.

 

What you will own

  • A P&L-relevant product area (logistics automation, pricing, or embedded finance) from discovery to shipped outcomes

  • Concrete targets, not vibes: we run on automation and retention metrics, and your area will have a number attached

  • Discovery with real users: traders, logistics operators, and buyers, weekly and in person

  • Prioritization and delivery with your engineering squad, including the calls on what not to build

  • Post-launch iteration driven by usage data and margin impact, not opinion

What you bring

  • 5+ years in product management with at least 2 at a B2B scale-up, owning a product area through significant growth

  • Shipped products in an operations-heavy domain: logistics, marketplaces, supply chain, fintech, or similar

  • Fluency with data: you pull your own numbers, define your own metrics, and change course when they tell you to

  • A track record of fast MVP cycles: built, measured, iterated or killed, and you can walk us through the decisions

  • Experience shipping AI-powered features to production is a strong plus

  • Fluent English; German is a plus, not a requirement

    What this role is not

  • Not a people-management role on day one. You'll lead through the product, with a path to building a team as the org scales.

  • Not a strategy-deck job. If your best work lives in slides rather than shipped product, this isn't the fit.

Who you are

  • You are slef-motivated, iterating fast, and eager for product success

  • You are a self-starter who takes ownership of a problem and makes sure it’s solved

  • You are comfortable with giving and receiving feedback for continuous improvement

  • A lifelong learner, someone who can dive into a domain quickly and become an expert

  • Data-informed, business-oriented and relentless in execution

We are an equal-opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, regardless of race, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, or any other characteristic. We believe that diversity drives innovation, creativity, and collective strength.

title: Staff Core Platform Engineer
description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to shape and evolve the core platform architecture that powers n8n — creating scalable, configurable foundations across execution, infrastructure, and frontend platform so 80+ product engineers and our open-source community can build confidently across cloud and self-hosted deployments.

Working across our platform teams, you’ll bring architectural coherence to the systems they jointly own and help us make the right long-term technical decisions as n8n scales:

Architectural direction across Core Platform

  • Drive architecture across the two Core Platform teams, ensuring execution, infrastructure, data, and frontend platform systems evolve as a coherent whole rather than independent components.

  • Design highly adaptable backend foundations that support different workloads, deployment models, shared product team needs, and future scale without creating unnecessary complexity.

  • Partner with the FE platform workstream on core canvas architecture, real-time communication, performance, plugin contracts, and other platform primitives used by product teams.

Execution, distributed systems & data foundations

  • Evolve core subsystems including durable workflow execution and state, orchestration, queue and task distribution, worker management, scheduling, and horizontal scaling.

  • Design for correctness and resilience across distributed environments, including failure modes, idempotency, state transitions, tenant isolation, and reliability guarantees.

  • Shape our data and persistence architecture, including database scaling, sharding, migration strategies, deployment abstractions, and long-term operational maintainability.

Platform architecture & engineering enablement

  • Lead consequential technical decisions through clear proposals and RFCs, making trade-offs explicit and aligning engineers and stakeholders around durable solutions.

  • Define stable platform interfaces and abstractions that reduce coupling, support safe migrations, and make the platform easier for feature teams to build on.

  • Mentor engineers across all engineering teams through design reviews, pairing, and technical guidance, raising the bar for architecture, system design, and maintainability.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🏗️ Staff-level architectural ownership: You have a track record of leading architecture across multiple systems or teams, including migrations, re-architectures, or foundational platform initiatives with long-term organizational impact.

  • 🧠 Systems thinking: You reason deeply about invariants, correctness, failure modes, boundaries, and trade-offs, and you’re comfortable making decisions where there is no obviously perfect solution.

  • ⚙️ Configurable systems at scale: You’ve designed highly configurable, adaptable systems that serve multiple use cases or operating modes without becoming brittle or excessively complex.

  • 🌐 Distributed systems depth: You’ve designed and operated distributed systems involving concepts such as asynchronous processing, idempotency, state machines, queues, consistency, and resilience.

  • 🗄️ Data architecture at scale: You’ve worked on data-intensive systems where persistence, performance, isolation, migrations, and operational reliability were meaningful architectural concerns.

  • 🛠️ TypeScript & Node.js depth: You have strong TypeScript experience and have built substantial backend systems with Node.js beyond conventional CRUD applications.

  • 🤝 Cross-team technical leadership: You influence through technical judgment, clear communication, RFCs, design reviews, and mentorship, helping multiple teams converge on better solutions without relying on formal authority.

  • 🧱 Platform enablement mindset: You care about creating clear contracts, abstractions, and developer experiences that allow other engineers to move faster and more safely.

  • 🧹 Long-horizon engineering: You’re energized by modularization, migrations, refactoring, and evolving existing systems while keeping the product and engineering organization moving.

Nice-to-haves

  • 🧰 Workflow, orchestration or devtools experience: You’ve worked on workflow engines, orchestration platforms, developer tools, or infrastructure-heavy SaaS products.

  • 🖥️ Frontend platform architecture: You’ve worked with architecture-heavy frontend systems such as canvas applications, plugin systems, real-time applications, web workers, or complex rendering environments.

  • 🧾 Durable execution patterns: You’ve designed or operated systems using event sourcing, sagas, durable execution, or related state-management patterns.

  • 👥 Multi-tenant architecture: You’ve designed systems where tenant isolation, resource management, data boundaries, or noisy-neighbour concerns were important.

  • 🌍 Open-source experience: You’ve contributed to or maintained open-source software and understand the additional pressure around public contracts and backward compatibility.

  • 📈 Large-scale SaaS exposure: You’ve operated systems at meaningful scale or worked in environments where reliability and architectural decisions had broad customer impact.

  • 🧩 Monolith → modular migrations: You’ve decomposed monolithic systems or led incremental architectural migrations without preventing product teams from continuing to ship.

  • ☁️ Multi-deployment awareness: You’ve designed products that need to work consistently across both managed cloud and self-hosted environments.

  • 🔭 Observability mindset: You think about instrumentation, debugging, incident response, rollout safety, and operability as part of system design rather than an afterthought.

  • 🧪 Strong CS grounding: You bring deep knowledge of distributed systems concepts, consistency models, consensus, formal methods, or similarly rigorous approaches to system correctness.

Why join us?

At n8n, you’ll work on the foundations that almost every product experience depends on. You’ll have influence across two Core Platform teams, helping shape how our execution engine, infrastructure, data architecture, and frontend platform evolve together as both our product and engineering organization scale.

This is a Staff role with real architectural leverage: you’ll tackle problems that span team boundaries, evolve systems that already operate at meaningful scale, and create platform capabilities that make 80+ engineers more effective. You’ll do that in a remote-first environment that values autonomy, thoughtful experimentation, and engineers who influence through strong technical judgment rather than hierarchy.

Sound like the kind of platform challenge you want to own?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • AI enablement 🤖 – We believe in working smarter—everyone gets an unlimited AI budget to explore and use the best tools to boost productivity and creativity.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

title: Data Scientist / Data Engineer
description:
About Nucs AI

Nucs AI is revolutionizing cancer care through cutting-edge AI and medical imaging technology. Founded in 2024 by a multidisciplinary team of oncologists, AI researchers, and healthcare innovators, we’re tackling one of medicine’s most pressing challenges: the growing demand for accurate, timely cancer diagnostics in the face of rising scan volumes and limited radiologist capacity.

We sit at the intersection of diagnostics and treatment planning - building AI-powered tools at the convergence of medical imaging, radioligand therapy, and artificial intelligence. Starting with prostate cancer and expanding across oncology, we partner with world-leading medical institutions and pharmaceutical companies across the US, Europe, and Australia to bring precision oncology into everyday clinical practice.

Our mission is to enhance diagnostic precision and expand access to expert-level cancer care, improving patient outcomes worldwide. We’re venture-backed, early-stage, and building a team that blends deep clinical expertise with engineering intensity - moving with the rigor the medical field demands and the speed the problem deserves.

What you'll do

  • Build auditable data pipelines for large clinical, diagnostic, and medical imaging datasets in the cloud.

  • Own statistical analysis across clinical studies, diagnostic performance, model evaluation, and data quality.

  • Apply classical machine learning and deep learning methods to data analysis problems.

  • Use LLM-based methods to extract structured data from clinical documents and reports.

  • Build dashboards and data observability tooling.

  • Investigate and document missing, inconsistent, invalid, and implausible data.

  • Maintain strong data lineage, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility across data workflows.

  • Produce analyses and supporting evidence that hold up in regulatory submissions and audits.


What we're looking for

  • 3+ years of relevant full-time experience in data science, data engineering, medical AI, medical imaging, or a closely related field.

  • Strong statistical depth applied to messy clinical or diagnostic data.

  • A track record of building and maintaining data pipelines at scale.

  • Comfort working with medical imaging formats including DICOM and NIfTI.

  • Practical experience with classical machine learning and explainable ML.

  • Working fluency with deep learning and modern LLM tooling.

  • Experience with cloud data infrastructure. We use GCP, but equivalent platforms are fine.

  • A strong working understanding of data lineage, provenance, traceability, and reproducibility.

  • Unusual attention to detail around data completeness, validity, consistency, and edge cases.

  • Flexibility at adapting to new technologies

  • Awareness of good software practices

Strongly preferred

  • Experience with imaging-based clinical trials, preferably in nuclear medicine.

  • Experience supporting FDA-cleared medical devices or EU MDR compliance.

  • Experience producing statistical analyses or technical evidence used in a regulatory submission.

  • Experience with DICOM de-identification and anonymization workflows.

  • Experience with model interpretability techniques such as SHAP.

Why Nucs AI

  • Mission with real impact  – Your work directly improves how cancer patients are diagnosed and treated.

  • Ground-floor opportunity  – Early-stage company, meaningful equity, and outsized influence on the direction we take.

  • World-class collaborators  – Work alongside leading oncologists, nuclear medicine physicians, and AI researchers globally.

  • Massive market tailwinds  – Radioligand therapy and AI-driven oncology are multi-billion dollar growth markets.

  • Autonomy and flexibility  – Remote-first, flexible working. We hire great people and trust them to deliver.

  • Equity upside  – Competitive equity package. We’re building something big and want you to share in it.

How to Apply

Submit your resume and a brief note on why this role and Nucs AI excite you.

Equal Opportunity

Nucs AI is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

title: Alpha Plant Systems Lead
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of the world’s first commercial fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

Shape the architecture of the world’s first net energy gain stellarator by taking full responsibility for the design, integration, and delivery of Alpha’s ancillary systems. You will own the system-level decisions that determine how breakthrough technology is integrated and delivered.

Taking accountability for the tritium fuel cycle, high voltage electrical power, heating sources, cryogenic and non-cryogenic cooling systems, and waste water treatment, you will also take total ownership of the complexity between them and the stellarator: the piping, distribution networks, and critical infrastructure that connect them. You will lead the team of teams translating the needs of Alpha into the physical delivery of major ancillaries, bridging in-house talent and external contractors.

Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges in industry: this role demands deep, hands-on technical judgement and the ability to make impactful design decisions across a wide range of tightly coupled disciplines to turn cutting-edge science into a functioning facility.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Drive integrated system design and delivery: Own the integrated design of the ancillary systems and all interconnecting infrastructure to seamlessly embed them into the wider Alpha facility.

  • Modernize the engineering approach: Bring a forward-thinking vision to the industrial facility development process by including, for example, advanced process engineering techniques, modern Building Information Modeling (BIM), and 4D assembly planning.

  • Own the interfaces and the budget: Manage complex trade-offs and resolve critical design constraints by collaborating closely with stellarator engineering and facility teams. You will own the budget for these systems and serve as the primary technical interface with external stakeholders and regulatory bodies.

  • Build systems with a fast-moving team: Combine systems thinking with a pragmatic execution mindset. You will lead across the ancillary systems, providing the judgement needed to unblock cross-system challenges and facility trade decisions.

  • Execute safe and successful operations: Define the safety logic and lead the integrated installation, commissioning, and maintenance strategies for Alpha’s ancillary systems.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

  • End-to-End Infrastructure Delivery: A proven track record owning major projects, from design through to construction, commissioning, and handover.

  • Relevant Industrial Experience: First-hand experience witnessing and delivering complex plant engineering and facilities. Broad backgrounds that are relevant for this role include manufacturing, data centers, refineries, chemical plants, or industrial gas production.

  • Deep Technical and Design Judgement: Strong technical skillsets beyond delivery management with the ability to lead design decisions regarding complex facility integration.

  • Systems & Execution Mindset: The ability to balance inputs from multidisciplinary technical teams and a bias to action in resolving critical trade-offs.

  • Agility and Leadership: Team players who thrive in fast moving, high growth environments. Demonstrated ability to manage large internal and external work packages.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

  • Recruiter Interview (30-45 min)

  • Technical Screening (30 min)

  • Technical Panel (3x60 min)

  • CEO call (30 min)

Successful applicants will be assigned to one of the Engineering teams within Proxima, depending on their specific skills, location, and the needs of the organisation.

This role sits at L4 of our framework, please inquire during the recruitment process for further information

To get there, we need a high-performing, diverse team that brings different perspectives, challenges assumptions, and builds together with purpose. We know that diversity of thought and experience leads to better ideas, stronger execution, and a more resilient team. We don’t look at how you identify, what you look like, who you choose to worship or what ethnicity you are. We care about what you can bring to the table.

title: 1st Level Support (m/w/d)
description:
Wenn im Restaurant das Terminal streikt, steht der Gast schon in der Schlange. Genau dann meldet sich jemand bei uns.

SO'USE ist eine Plattform für digitales Bestellen und Bezahlen in der Gastronomie. Gäste scannen einen QR-Code oder tippen am Self-Order-Terminal, bestellen selbst und zahlen direkt – die Bestellung landet ohne Umweg in der Kasse und auf dem Küchendisplay. Dazu kommen Webshop, Tablet-Bestellung und die Anbindung von Lieferdiensten wie Lieferando, Wolt und Uber Eats. Über 1.500 Betriebe arbeiten damit täglich: vom Foodtruck über Bäckereiketten bis zu HANS IM GLÜCK.

Das heißt auch: Unsere Software läuft im laufenden Mittagsgeschäft. Der 1st Level Support ist die erste Stimme, die Gastronominnen und Gastronomen hören, wenn etwas hakt – und meistens auch die, die das Problem löst.

Aufgaben

  • Du bearbeitest die Anliegen unserer Kunden über unser Ticketsystem, überwiegend schriftlich und teilweise per Telefon.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Account Management zusammen, entlastest das Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass Kunden schnell eine Antwort bekommen statt einer Warteschleife.
  • Bei kniffligen Fällen entscheidest du, ob es an den 2nd Level Support geht, und koordinierst die Weitergabe bis zur Lösung.
  • Nach dem Onboarding hörst du nicht auf zu lernen: Du gräbst dich weiter in die Funktionen unseres Systems ein, damit du beim nächsten Mal schon weißt, woran es liegt.
  • Du übernimmst Bereitschaftszeiten: Gastronomie läuft abends und am Wochenende, deshalb werden wichtige Tickets und Anrufe auch außerhalb der regulären Arbeitszeit bearbeitet. Diese Zeiten vergüten wir zusätzlich, und wie oft und in welchem Rhythmus du sie übernimmst, legen wir gemeinsam fest.

Qualifikation

  • Gastro-Background. Du hast selbst im Service, in der Küche oder in Gastronomienahen Tech-Unternehmen gearbeitet und weißt, wie sich ein voller Laden anfühlt. Das ist uns wichtig – unsere Kunden merken sofort, ob jemand ihren Alltag kennt.
  • Klare Sprache, schriftlich wie am Telefon. Du erklärst technische Dinge so, dass sie zwischen zwei Bestellungen verständlich sind.
  • Technische Affinität. Du hast keine Angst vor Systemeinstellungen, Schnittstellen oder einem Blick in den Quelltext einer Website – und du nutzt KI-Tools bereits selbstverständlich, um schneller zu Antworten zu kommen.
  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe. Neue Prozesse und Produktdetails sind für dich kein Hindernis, sondern der interessante Teil.

Berufserfahrung im Support ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss. Wenn du aus der Gastronomie kommst und Lust auf die technische Seite hast, bring dich ins Gespräch.

Benefits

  • 45.000 bis 50.000 Euro Jahresgehalt, je nach Erfahrung, plus Bonussystem. Bereitschaftszeiten vergüten wir zusätzlich.
  • Perspektive über den Support hinaus. Wer bei uns die Kunden und das Produkt kennt, ist die beste Besetzung für Key Account Management, Kunden-Onboarding oder Customer Success. Diese Wege stehen dir offen – wir sind sie intern schon mehrfach gegangen.
  • Arbeitsplatz in Leipzigs Mitte oder remote. Wir sitzen gern zusammen im Büro, aber wenn du von woanders arbeitest, funktioniert das genauso.
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, flache Hierarchien und echten Gestaltungsspielraum in einem Bereich, der sich schnell entwickelt.
  • Ein Team, das dich weiterbringt: entspannter Umgang, regelmäßiges Feedback und Workshops statt Jahresgespräch.

Klingt das nach dir?

Dann schreib uns – ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben und dein Lebenslauf reichen völlig aus. Erzähl uns dabei gern, aus welchem Laden du kommst.

Du möchtest vorher mehr über uns wissen? Schau auf unserer Website vorbei oder folge uns auf Instagram (@souse_germany) und LinkedIn (SO'USE).

title: Customer Success - DACH
description:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $11B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

This is a builder's role, where you'll own both the technical depth and commercial outcomes for some of ElevenLabs' most exciting customers across the DACH region (Germany, Austria, Switzerland), sitting at the intersection of product, engineering, and revenue.

You'll get ahead of the problem. You'll dig into how customers deploy ElevenLabs across web, mobile, and their systems, spot the problems before they do, inspire new use-cases and own the solution end to end. You'll own the number too: renewals, expansion and cross-sell. Success here means driving real revenue retention and growth for your book of business.

 

What this looks like day to day

You'll run onboarding, enablement, and growth across ElevenLabs' full platform, core speech models, creative tools, and Agents. You'll advise customers on production deployment, not just theory, digging into usage and performance data to catch friction early and keep adoption moving.

You'll also own commercial outcomes for a defined book of business against clear targets: Gross Revenue Retention, Net Revenue Retention, cross-sell, and net expansion. You'll spot expansion opportunities early, own renewals and upsells end to end, and work closely with Sales, Engineering, and CS leadership to turn technical wins into revenue.

 

Requirements

  • 5+ years of Customer Success, Account Management or Technical Account Management experience supporting complex B2B SaaS, Developer Tools, or AI/ML products in the DACH region

  • Proven experience of owning and managing a defined Book of Business

  • Fluent in German and English

  • Proven experience working across the DACH market. Knowledge of the landscape and cultural nuances

  • Familiarity and experience with building and deploying AI agents

  • Strong builder mindset - you thrive in ambiguity and being a pioneer, finding ways to innovate across a full region or market to drive revenue outcomes

  • Familiarity and experience with API Integrations, and comfort and knowledge of navigating SDKs

  • Proven experience working cross functionally with Sales, Engineering, Product, and Marketing teams

  • Proven experience driving revenue outcomes, including owning a revenue quota and identifying, qualifying, and closing cross-sell opportunities along with renewals

  • Excellent problem-solving, technical, and analytical skills to address customer needs and concerns

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with customers at all levels of an organization

  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote or distributed team environment

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in Germany, Austria, or Switzerland.

title: Team Lead Account Management (f/m/d)
description:
Über Zenjob

Zenjob ist eine KI-gestützte Plattform für flexible Personallösungen, die seit 2015 Unternehmen und kurzfristig einsatzbereite Mitarbeitende effizient miteinander verbindet. Unternehmen nutzen unsere Buchungsplattform, um Personalbedarf in Echtzeit zu decken, während Studierende unsere Zenjob App nutzen, um Nebenjobs zu finden, die sich optimal mit ihrem Studium vereinbaren lassen. Über 40.000 Zenjobber und 1.000 Partnerunternehmen aus Logistik, Einzelhandel und Gastronomie in allen großen deutschen Städten teilen unseren Glauben daran, dass gute Arbeit kein Zufall ist. Sie ist das Ergebnis innovativer Technologie und echter Leidenschaft. Gute Arbeit beginnt hier.

Über die Rolle

Diese Rolle ist ein Sales-Job mit Führungsverantwortung – keine klassische Customer-Success-Teamleitung.

Als Team Lead Account Management verantwortest du das Umsatzwachstum unserer Bestandskunden in deinem Vertical. Du führst dein Team von Account Managern auf Wachstum, gewinnst inaktive Kunden zurück und verantwortest Retention sowie Service-Exzellenz im gesamten Vertical.

Entscheidend: Du lebst “lead by example” und bist selbst Front Runner bei Kunden. Das bedeutet, dass du selbst ein eigenes Portfolio strategischer Enterprise Accounts betreust. Du gehst auf Kundentermine, verhandelst Preise und Verträge auf Augenhöhe und bleibst vertrieblich absolut fit. Denn nur wer selbst verkauft, berät und verhandelt, kann sein Team glaubwürdig dorthin entwickeln und coachen. Lead by Example ist bei uns kein Buzzword, sondern essentieller Bestandteil der Rolle.

Was du tun wirst

Eigenes Portfolio – du sitzt selbst mit am Steuer

  • Du betreust ein eigenes aktives Portfolio strategischer Enterprise Accounts und führst regelmäßig eigene Kundentermine – online und vor Ort

  • Du führst Vertrags- und Preisverhandlungen auf Augenhöhe und moderierst kritische Verhandlungssituationen

Wachstum, Retention und Reaktivierung im Vertical

  • Du stellst sicher, dass Neukunden ab Tag eins strukturiert onboarded und schnellstmöglich zu aktiv buchenden Kunden entwickelt werden

  • Du kennst dein Risiko-Portfolio jederzeit, greifst bei Kündigungsrisiken proaktiv ein und löst sie dort, wo sie entstehen

  • Du hast den Blick für schlafende Riesen: Du identifizierst inaktive Accounts systematisch und erweckst sie durch gezielte persönliche Ansprache wieder zum Leben – selbst oder an der Seite deines Teams

Führung als Player Coach

  • Du begleitest deine Account Manager als strategischer Sparringspartner bei schwierigen Gesprächen, Jahresverhandlungen und Erstpräsentationen – als Coach auf Augenhöhe, nicht als Aufpasser

  • Du prüfst Kundenkonzepte und Angebote deines Teams kritisch, benennst Lücken klar und nimmst Pitches ab, bevor sie beim Kunden landen

  • Du gibst unmittelbares, konkretes Feedback zu Gesprächsführung, Verhandlungsgeschick, Konzeptqualität und Priorisierung – täglich, nicht erst im Jahresgespräch

  • Deine 1:1s sind Portfolio- und Pipeline-Reviews mit Blick nach vorn, keine rückblickenden Statusupdates

  • Du übernimmst keine Probleme deines Teams ungefiltert, sondern gibst sie mit Kontext und strategischer Einordnung zurück – Hilfe zur Selbsthilfe

  • Du entwickelst deine Account Manager konsequent zu strategischen Beratern und kommerziellen Projektleitern ihres Portfolios

Steuerung und Marktintelligenz

  • Du steuerst dein Team datenbasiert und konsequent auf Ergebnisse; saubere CRM-Disziplin ist für dich die Grundlage verlässlicher Forecasts

  • Wenn die Zahlen nicht stimmen, betreibst du strukturelle Ursachenforschung und löst das Problem Schritt für Schritt

  • Du setzt die Qualitätsmesslatte für Gesprächsvorbereitung, Konzepte und Kundenkommunikation hoch und korrigierst Abweichungen proaktiv

  • Du trägst Insights zu Markt, Accounts und Wettbewerb konsolidiert in die Organisation – Sales informiert die Organisation, nicht umgekehrt

  • Eskalationen gibst du nie ungefiltert weiter, sondern immer mit fundierter Einschätzung und konkreten Lösungsoptionen

Dein Mindset: kommerzieller Drive statt Verwaltung

  • Vertriebs-DNA: Kundentermine sind für dich die schnellste und wertvollste Quelle für Insights und nachhaltiges Account-Wachstum.

  • Lead by Example: Akzeptanz und Vertrauen im Team verdienst du dir durch eigene Taten – nur wer selbst verhandelt, verkauft und berät, inspiriert als kommerzielles Vorbild.

  • Impact über Aktivität: Am Ende des Quartals zählt, ob ein Kunde bleibt, expandiert oder zurückgewonnen wird. Ein voller Kalender ohne messbaren Output ist kein Ergebnis.

  • Unternehmerische Haltung: Du entscheidest eigenständig über Portfoliostrategie, Kundenpriorisierung und Reaktivierungsplanung in deinem Vertical.

Woran du gemessen wirst

Die konkreten Zielwerte setzen wir quartalsweise. Gemessen wird an:

  • Wachstum: Portfolio-Gross-Revenue und Umsatzwachstum im Bestand durch Up- und Cross-Selling

  • Retention: Churn-Rate und Retention im Vertical

  • Incubation: Konversionsrate nach der vierten Buchungswoche

  • Reaktivierung: Anzahl und Umsatzvolumen zurückgewonnener Accounts

  • Eigene Kundenpräsenz: Quote und strategischer Impact deiner eigenen Kundentermine

  • Teamentwicklung: eigenständige Gesprächsführung, Outreach-Aktivität und Beratungskompetenz deiner Account Manager

Was du mitbringst

  • Erfahrung im Key Account Management oder strategischen Vertrieb mit größeren Enterprise-Kunden

title: Product Manager - Studio Monitors (m/f/d) - ADAM Audio GmbH
description:
Product Manager - Studio Monitors (m/f/d) – ADAM Audio GmbH

Location: Berlin office / hybrid (Berlin preferred)

Term: Full-time, permanent

Salary: Depending on experience

Start date: as soon as possible

Travel: Up to 20% (trade shows, studio visits, JDM/ODM partners)

  • Are you passionate about professional studio monitors and the craft of making music?
  • Do you have a strong track record in hardware product management?
  • Do you enjoy working in fast-paced, cross-functional teams to bring exciting and technically challenging new product ideas to life?

We are looking for a forward-thinking and experienced Product Manager to own one or more of our active studio monitor lines end-to-end - from customer insight and business case, through requirements definition and stage-gate development, to launch and life in the market.

Reporting to the Head of Product, you will be the cross-functional centre of your line(s) and make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing that get exceptional monitors into the hands of the creatives, engineers, producers and mixers who trust ADAM Audio.

Role and responsibilities:

  • You will own the full lifecycle of one or more assigned studio monitor lines through opportunity framing, pre-development, stage-gate delivery, release and post-launch.
  • You will monitor, document and analyse customer needs, production workflows, competitor moves and channel dynamics through structured desk research, user interviews, studio visits, dealer feedback, industry research and product testing - turning that into a defensible point of view for the roadmap.
  • Working in close collaboration with the sales regions during the entire PM process, you will build structured proposals and business cases for new products, refreshes and running changes - including ASP, target BOM, gross margin, volume scenarios and pricing recommendation - for evaluation by Product Leadership and the Exec Team.
  • You will translate opportunities into concise PRDs with clear acceptance criteria, balancing user value against technical feasibility across acoustics, electronics, firmware, software, and mechanics.
  • You will partner with R&D, Project Management, JDM/ODM partners, Operations and Marketing, to make trade-offs on features, performance, cost and timing to meet market windows and business objectives.
  • You will act as the internal hub across ADAM Audio, ensuring coordination and information flow across R&D, Sales, Marketing, Operations and Support throughout development and commercialisation.
  • You will support go-to-market with pricing strategy, competitive positioning, messaging and go-to-market artefacts (data-sheets, user guides, documentation); track post-launch performance and adjust strategy accordingly.
  • You will monitor in-market response and quality (warranty rates, returns, support tickets, dealer feedback) and prioritise maintenance releases, firmware updates and running changes based on business and user impact.
  • You will represent your products at internal and external events - trade conferences, dealer visits, product launches - and act as a credible point of contact for users.
  • Individual and team development is important, and we will support you as you look for ways to grow and improve your personal knowledge and skills. We will also be looking for you to own and help improve our approach to engineering and design knowledge, including best practices, processes, and tools. There will be the opportunity to share knowledge and practices with all companies across the Focusrite group.

Skills and Experience:

  • Minimum 5 years of Hardware Product Management experience in professional audio or consumer electronics.
  • A working command of the loudspeaker stack to be a credible peer to R&D; you can specify a frequency plot and ask the right questions on the measurements.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen, with the ability to author a business case, build volume and margin scenarios and reason about unit economics.
  • Confidence in designing and running listening tests, structured user interviews and studio visits, and translating subjective audio judgement and objective measurement into specific, actionable requirements.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken - German language skills are a strong advantage.
  • Comfort in working autonomously in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and juggling multiple large projects simultaneously.
  • A genuine passion for music, audio and the creative process, with a feel for what studio professionals actually do with our products.
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of the time (trade shows, studio visits, JDM partners in Asia, Focusrite Group regional visits).

Beneficial Qualifications:

  • A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Physics, Music Technology, Business or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent is a plus.
  • Direct experience in studio monitors, live sound, hi-fi loudspeakers or other professional acoustic products.
  • Experience working across regional sales organisations inside a group structure.
  • Familiarity with Asian culture and etiquette (JDM/ODM partner management).

You don’t meet every single requirement?

We’re looking for people who will thrive in our team and contribute to our culture—not just candidates who tick every box. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly match every qualification listed, we’d still love to hear from you. Tell us what you would bring to the role and why you’d be a great addition to the team.

We believe that diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds make us stronger. As an inclusive employer, we welcome applications from all qualified candidates, including people with disabilities. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, please let us know—we’ll be happy to support you.

We look forward to receiving your application!

About us

ADAM Audio GmbH is a rapidly growing, internationally positioned Focusrite plc company based in Berlin Adlershof.

We are one of the market-leading manufacturers of professional monitoring solutions.  

Our customers include renowned recording studios and well-known music producers all over the world, and our products have also been used to soundtrack numerous Oscar-nominated films in recent years.

Since 2019, ADAM Audio has been part of Focusrite plc which houses other, highly respected pro audio brands like Martin Audio, Optimal Audio, Sequential, Focusrite, Focusrite Pro, Novation and Ampify. Our international team at the Berlin-based HQ and the office in China live our passion for music. We constantly drive ourselves to bring fresh ideas and new technologies to our high-quality products to meet the needs of pro audio enthusiasts and recording professionals alike.

We pride ourselves in providing some of the tools that empower creatives all over the world to bring their visions to life. Covering a wide range of products for different levels and budgets, we engage with artists, producers and engineers to become a companion throughout the various stages of their journey.

Our whole business is structured to let everyone contribute and be heard at all levels, and we make sure it’s a great place to work. As a team, we work hard and support each other to master our individual tasks, building and developing the skills of talented and passionate people – to achieve a common goal. So, if you think you can bring something new to the mix, we look forward to hearing from you.

ADAM Audio is an equal opportunity employer. Our employees span a wide range of diverse backgrounds, and we believe that embracing diversity is one of the keys to our future success.

If you want to learn more about the ADAM Audio brand, please go to www.adam-audio.com

  • Du hilfst beim Community Management – du beantwortest Kommentare und Nachrichten und sorgst dafür, dass sich unsere Community gesehen fühlt

E-Commerce & Shop Support

  • Du hilfst dabei, die Customer Journey nach dem Kauf zu verbessern (z. B. E-Mail-Flows, Bestellbestätigungen, Bewertungs- und Wiederkauf-Anstöße)
  • Du unterstützt bei kleineren Aufgaben rund um unseren Onlineshop, damit das Einkaufserlebnis rund und hochwertig bleibt

  • Du unterstützt direkt unsere Head of Marketing und bekommst tiefe Einblicke in das D2C-Marketing
  • Du arbeitest an Themen mit, die einen sichtbaren Einfluss auf Reichweite, Community und Umsatz haben
  • Du lernst, wie Content, Social Media, Kooperationen und E-Commerce ineinandergreifen – praxisnah und von Anfang an mit Verantwortung
  • Du übernimmst eigene kleine Projekte, statt nur zuzuarbeiten

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringen solltest

  • Du absolvierst ein Studium (z. B. Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien, BWL oder Vergleichbares) und benötigst ein Pflichtpraktikum über 6 Monate
  • Erste Berührungspunkte mit Social Media, Content oder Marketing – z. B. durch Studium, eigene Kanäle, Werkstudierendenjobs oder frühere Praktika
  • Freude an Content, Storytelling und dem, was auf Social Media gerade passiert
  • Strukturierte, zuverlässige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise
  • Ein gutes Gespür für Ästhetik, Sprache und Marken
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

Das wäre ein großes Plus

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Instagram-Content, UGC oder der Zusammenarbeit mit Creator:innen
  • Grundkenntnisse in Adobe-Tools (z. B. Premiere Pro, Photoshop, Lightroom) oder Tools wie Canva, CapCut und der Meta Business Suite
  • Lust, auch selbst vor die Kamera zu gehen – für Social-Media-Content und unsere Ads Interesse an E-Commerce und daran, wie ein Onlineshop wächst

title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer (x/f/m)
Creative Director – Design & Brand (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Die Beratungsbranche in Deutschland sieht überall gleich aus. Gleiche Bildwelten, gleiche Stockfotos, gleiche Blautöne, gleiche Sprache. Marke ist in diesem Markt praktisch unbesetzt.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. Etablierte Mandanten, lange Erfahrung, starke Wachstumsbasis. Daraus bauen wir das Beratungshaus für den deutschen Mittelstand, und wir bauen es schnell. Diesen Markt gewinnt nicht, wer den besseren Fachaufsatz schreibt, sondern wer als Marke dauerhaft präsent ist und den Markt anführt — bei Unternehmern genauso wie bei den Menschen, die wir für uns gewinnen wollen. Genau diese Marke bauen wir: ikonisch, unverwechselbar, und in dieser Branche gibt es sie noch nicht. Design ist deshalb keine Abteilung am Ende der Kette: Was wir bauen, wird aus einer Designperspektive gedacht.

Du bist Grafikdesigner mit außergewöhnlichem visuellem Gespür und einem Portfolio, das für sich spricht. Du kommst aus einer Agentur, einem eigenen Studio oder von einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System. Du wechselst, weil du dort immer nur einen Teilbereich verantwortest — eine Kampagne, ein Relaunch, eine Strecke im System — und nie die Marke als Ganzes samt der Experience dahinter verantworten und führen darfst. Genau das willst du: die volle visuelle Verantwortung, mit einem Auftraggeber, der dir das Urteil nicht wegnimmt. Bei Vogel findest du beides: Strukturen, die tragen, und ein Setup, das jeden Tag nach vorne geht. Kein Konzern-Korsett. Kein Aufbau-Versprechen ohne Boden.

Du verantwortest das gesamte visuelle System von Vogel und der weiteren Marken, die daneben entstehen — Print, Digital, Raum, Bewegtbild, Experience. Du setzt selbst um und ziehst Partner dort zu, wo Kapazität oder Spezialisierung es erfordert. Du berichtest direkt an die Geschäftsführung. Die Rolle sitzt in München, vor Ort. Die natürliche Entwicklung führt nach 24 bis 36 Monaten in die fachliche Führung des Design- und Brand-Bereichs.

Deine Verantwortung

Visuelles System und Markenführung

  • Du verantwortest das Designsystem von Vogel — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache, Layout-Prinzipien, Komponenten — und entwickelst es weiter, statt es nur zu verwalten.

  • Du überträgst das System in Content: Social, Publikationen, Whitepaper, Präsentationen, Recruiting-Material. Das System ist erst fertig, wenn andere im Unternehmen damit arbeiten können, ohne dich zu fragen.

  • Du setzt die visuellen Systeme der weiteren Marken auf, die bei Vogel entstehen.

  • Dein Maßstab: Wer drei unserer Touchpoints nebeneinander sieht, erkennt sie ohne Logo als Vogel.

Gestaltung über alle Medien

  • Print: Publikationen, Geschäftsausstattung, Mandantenkommunikation, Kampagnenmotive — von der ersten Skizze bis zur Druckfreigabe in deiner Hand.

  • Webdesign: Du gestaltest vogel-beratung.com und die dazugehörigen Seiten weiter, im direkten Austausch mit unserem Webentwickler. Darüber hinaus verantwortest du das Webdesign für alle Standorte und Gesellschaften der Vogel-Gruppe.

  • Eventdesign und räumliche Gestaltung: Standorte, Bühnen, eigene Veranstaltungsformate, Messeauftritte. Du gestaltest, wie Vogel sich anfühlt, wenn man im Raum steht.

  • Experience Design: Du denkst den Weg von Mandanten und Bewerbern als gestaltete Abfolge, nicht als Sammlung einzelner Assets.

Kreativ-Steuerung, Partner und Nachwuchs

  • Du steuerst Agenturen, Kreativpartner, Fotografen und Freelancer — Briefing, Auswahl, Qualitätsurteil, Freigabe. Zugeliefert wird Kapazität, die Handschrift bleibt deine.

  • Du steuerst Motion Design von der Konzeption bis zur Abnahme und stellst sicher, dass Bewegtbild aus demselben System kommt wie alles andere.

  • Du leitest unsere Design-Praktikanten und Berufseinsteiger fachlich an, gibst Feedback am Handwerk und baust darauf perspektivisch dein eigenes Team auf.

  • Du arbeitest in einem Umfeld, das hierarchisch in der Entscheidung, flach in der Kommunikation und autonom in der Ausführung ist. Leistung wird gefeiert, nicht versteckt — wer vorankommen will, weil er gut ist, findet hier den Raum dafür, ohne politische Tarnung und ohne Konsens-Theater.

Deine Perspektiven

Was du nach 6 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Du hast das visuelle System ausgebaut — Typografie, Farbe, Bildsprache und Komponenten sind erkennbar weiterentwickelt, nicht nur inventarisiert.

  • Du hast vogel-beratung.com überarbeitet, die neuen Seiten sind live.

  • Du bist der zentrale Ansprechpartner für alle Designthemen im Unternehmen — Anfragen laufen bei dir zusammen, statt bei Externen zu landen.

  • Du lieferst konstanten Output an Assets über alle Kanäle, ohne dass Themen liegen bleiben.

  • Die Marke beginnt, deine Handschrift zu tragen.

Was du nach 12 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Das Designsystem ist in Figma so aufgesetzt, dass Content-, Growth- und Recruiting-Themen ohne dich sauber daraus produzieren.

  • Die täglichen Assets aus dem Beratungsalltag — Präsentationen, Slides, Mandantenunterlagen — entstehen automatisiert per KI auf Basis deines Designsystems. Dass das trägt, hängt an sauberer Dokumentation und einem belastbaren technischen Setup: beides liegt bei dir.

  • Das Designsystem und die Assets aller Sub-Marken der Vogel-Gruppe sind ausgebaut und angewendet — jede Marke hat ein eigenes visuelles Fundament, das erkennbar aus derselben Logik kommt.

  • Dein Partner-Setup steht: ausgewählte Agenturen und Kreativpartner, klare Briefing-Standards, Qualitätsurteil bei dir.

  • Motion Design läuft als eigener Produktionsstrang unter deiner Steuerung.

Was du nach 24 Monaten geliefert hast:

  • Vogel ist visuell unverwechselbar — im Markt zuordenbar, ohne dass ein Logo nötig ist.

  • Eine neue Marke setzt du visuell in Wochen auf, nicht in Quartalen — das System trägt das, ohne dass du jedes Asset selbst baust.

  • Du hast mindestens einen Junior-Designer eingestellt, eingearbeitet und auf ein Niveau gebracht, auf dem er eigene Strecken trägt.

Wohin sich die Stelle entwickelt:

Der nächste Schritt ist die fachliche Führung von Design und Brand über alle Marken hinweg (IC-Karriere) — das setzt ein visuelles System voraus, das ohne dich trägt, nicht nur zusätzliche Berufsjahre. Wenn du das Team mit aufbaust und führen willst, öffnet sich zusätzlich die Führungslaufbahn. Wir kennen keinen Automatismus „mehr Erfahrung gleich höhere Stufe".

Das bringst du mit

Erfahrung & Track Record

  • Du hast ein Portfolio auf höchstem Niveau — Grafikdesign, Typografie, Branding-Systeme, visuelles Storytelling. Das Portfolio entscheidet, nicht der Lebenslauf.

  • Du hast in einem professionellen Setup produziert: Agentur mit Design- oder Branding-Fokus, eigenes Studio, oder Inhouse bei einer Marke mit starkem visuellem System. Berufsjahre sind für uns ein Indiz, kein Kriterium — wir entscheiden an Arbeiten und an Umsetzungsfähigkeit.

  • Du hast Kommunikationsdesign, Grafikdesign, visuelle Kommunikation oder Vergleichbares studiert — oder du hast dir das Handwerk selbst beigebracht und kannst das mit Arbeiten belegen, die den Abschluss ersetzen.

  • Profile, die nicht in das obige Raster passen, aber visuelles Urteil und Umsetzungstiefe mitbringen, sind ausdrücklich eingeladen — wir bewerten am Beitrag, nicht am Etikett. Konkret: Designer aus einem kleinen Studio ohne große Namen, dessen Arbeiten besser sind als das, was große Agenturen abliefern; Art Director aus einem Feld weit weg von B2B — Mode, Kultur, Gastronomie, Musik — mit systemischem Denken; Architekt oder Szenograf mit ausgeprägtem Gespür für Typografie und Fläche; Autodidakt mit eigenem Magazin, Label oder Projekt, das visuell trägt. Die ausgewiesene Range ist auf das Primärprofil ausgelegt. Wer einen anderen Hintergrund mitbringt, startet zu einem anderen Marktpreis und konvergiert nach zwölf Monaten bewährter Leistung auf das Rollen-Niveau — die Logik dahinter steht in unseren Vergütungsgrundsätzen.

Skills & Arbeitsweise

  • Du beherrschst die Adobe Creative Cloud auf Produktionsniveau — InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop — und Figma als Systemwerkzeug.

  • Du kannst Webdesign so übergeben, dass es umsetzbar ist. Ein Grundverständnis von HTML und CSS hilft, ist aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Du hast Motion-Grundlagen — genug, um zu briefen, zu steuern und Ergebnisse zu beurteilen. Mehr ist willkommen.

title: Social Media & Content Growth Expert (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Reichweite entsteht heute nicht durch einzelne gute Beiträge, sondern durch Systeme, die jeden Tag gute Beiträge ausspielen. Wer im Feed gegen Frequenz, Konsistenz und Distributionsmechanik antritt und dabei auf gelegentliche Kreativität setzt, verliert — unabhängig davon, wie gut der einzelne Post war.

Vogel ist eine der erfolgreichsten mittelständischen Beratungsgesellschaften in Deutschland — mehrere Tausend mittelständische Unternehmen vertrauen uns ihre Steuer-, kaufmännischen und strategischen Themen an. In dieser Bewegung ist Sichtbarkeit kein Nebenschauplatz: Mandanten, Talent und Multiplikatoren entscheiden zunehmend über das, was sie von uns online sehen. Was fehlt, ist die Person, die daraus ein System baut — und nicht nur einen Kalender füllt.

Du kommst aus Growth, Social oder Content — von einem B2B-Scaleup, einer Media- oder Creator-Brand, einer performance-getriebenen Consumer-Marke oder aus dem eigenen Kanal. Du wechselst, weil dein aktuelles Setup dich entweder in Kanal-Detailoptimierung ohne eigene Handschrift festhält oder in Content-Produktion ohne Systemhebel. Du verantwortest die Orchestrierung aller Vogel-Social-Kanäle und die Content-Pipeline dahinter — von der Themenfindung über AI-gestützte Produktion bis zu Distribution und Interaktion.   • Baue die Pipeline von der Themenfindung bis zur Veröffentlichung als getakteten Prozess — Themen-Backlog aus Beratungsalltag, Fachthemen und Mandantenfragen, AI-gestützte Entwurfsproduktion, redaktionelle Schärfung, Distribution, Nachverwertung.

  • Schreibe selbst, über alle Kanäle hinweg — Beiträge, Skripte, Kanaltexte, Kommentare. Auch für ein sperriges Thema findest du die Form, in der es gelesen wird. Das Handwerk hier ist Sprache, Ton und Gespür für Wirkung.

  • Automatisiere dort, wo Automatisierung Skalierung schafft — Recherche, Entwurfsproduktion, Wiederverwertung bestehender Inhalte, Distribution über mehrere Kanäle, wiederkehrende Interaktion. Du erkennst die Stellen, an denen ein System mehr Wirkung bringt als eine zusätzliche Person, und du baust es.

  • Steuere über Zahlen — Reichweite, Engagement-Qualität, Profilaufrufe, Bewerbungen und Mandantenanfragen mit erkennbarer Content-Herkunft. Formate ohne Wirkung fliegen aus dem Kalender, auch die schönen.

title: PHP-Entwickler / Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung (m/w/d) | Berlin-Mitte | Vollzeit
description:

Weil wir betreiben, was wir bauen, endet deine Arbeit nicht mit dem Go-live: Du siehst über Jahre, was aus deinem Code wird, und echte Kunden nutzen ihn täglich. Die Stelle ist dabei auf Entwicklung angelegt, auch auf deine: Wer Verantwortung übernimmt, wächst bei uns zum Lead Developer, langfristig bis zur CTO-Rolle.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst abwechslungsreiche Individualsoftware
  • Du setzt REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Fachverfahren und Drittsystemen um
  • Du übernimmst langfristige Verantwortung für laufende Anwendungen: Updates, Sicherheits-Patches, Performance-Optimierung und Monitoring
  • Du arbeitest mit einem modernen Stack: Laravel, Livewire, MySQL, Redis, Docker, FrankenPHP und Caddy, Azure/AWS
  • Du arbeitest nach Scrum mit DevOps-Boards, machst Code Reviews im Team
  • Du stimmst dich direkt mit unseren langjährigen Kunden ab

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Anwendungsentwicklung, ein Studium im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der PHP-Entwicklung
  • Wesentliche Beteiligung an mindestens zwei PHP-Softwareprojekten, die produktiv im Einsatz sind oder waren
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Laravel (Eloquent, Queues, Testing etc.)
  • Erfahrung mit mind. einem JavaScript-Framework wie Vue.js, React oder Alpine.js
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MySQL und sauberem Datenbankdesign
  • Docker Compose gehört zu deinem Entwickleralltag, Erfahrung mit Kubernetes ist ein Plus
  • Erfahrung mit Azure oder AWS ist ein Plus
  • Routinierter Git-Workflow mit Pull Requests und Code Reviews
  • Erfahrung mit REST-APIs und Schnittstellen zu Drittsystemen
  • Lust auf lebenslanges Lernen: neue Technologien, Programmiersprachen und Frameworks
  • Zuverlässigkeit, eigenständige Arbeitsweise und Hands-On-Mentalität
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf C1-Niveau (Projektsprache mit den meisten Kunden ist Deutsch)

Benefits

Das bieten wir

  • Entwicklungsperspektive zum Lead Developer mit technischer Leitung und langfristig bis zur CTO-Rolle
  • Attraktives Gehalt je nach Abschluss und Erfahrung sowie Projektfunktionszulagen
  • Sicherer, unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag in Vollzeit

Requirements

  • Shape the strategic vision and direction for Supercell’s Performance Marketing function, ensuring alignment with company and game-level business goals. Drive cross-functional alignment through openness, integrity, and collaboration – ensuring clarity of direction across marketing, analytics, and operations.

This includes using AI for workflow automation, creative production, and campaign optimization, while staying honest about the trade-offs involved.

This role can be based either in Helsinki or London. The team members are located in both our Helsinki and London Studios; however, most of our team members and stakeholders are located in Helsinki!

To be successful, you'll be expected to travel regularly in this role, especially if based out of London.

Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

About SIMBA Voice Agents by Speechify
 
SIMBA lets companies deploy natural, human-sounding AI voice agents in 71+ languages with sub-second latency. We don't just hand customers a product and wish them luck — every customer gets a Forward Deployed Engineer who builds their agents, joins their Slack, and iterates with them weekly. We're building the future of voice AI, and we're looking for someone who can sell that vision and help bring it to life

About the Role

As an Account Executive / Go-to-Market, you're equal parts dealmaker and builder. You'll own the full sales cycle for new customers — from first call to close — while also getting hands-on during technical evaluations, demos, and early deployment. You understand that selling voice AI isn't just about pitching features; it's about showing prospects exactly how SIMBA fits into their world and making that first integration feel effortless.

This is a rare role for someone who can command a boardroom and open a terminal.

What You'll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting through close for mid-market and enterprise accounts
  • Run technically deep discovery calls to understand customer use cases, tech stack, and integration requirements
  • Build and demo custom voice agent prototypes during the sales process to accelerate buy-in
  • Partner with Forward Deployed Engineers to ensure a seamless handoff from sale to onboarding
  • Develop GTM playbooks, messaging, and outbound strategies to help SIMBA break into new verticals
  • Represent customer needs internally, influencing product roadmap and packaging decisions
  • Maintain a clean pipeline in CRM and accurately forecast revenue
What We're Looking For
  • 3–6 years of experience in a sales, account executive, or GTM role at a technical B2B company
  • Track record of closing deals with both technical buyers (CTOs, engineers) and business stakeholders
  • Comfortable getting hands-on with APIs and no-code/low-code tools to build compelling demos
  • Strong understanding of the AI/ML or voice technology landscape — you follow this space closely
  • Exceptional communicator who can simplify complex technical concepts without losing their depth
  • Highly self-directed with strong pipeline discipline and a bias toward action
Nice to Have
  • Experience selling AI, voice, or conversational technology
  • Familiarity with telephony infrastructure, contact centers, or customer experience platforms
  • Prior experience in a forward deployment or solutions engineering capacity
  • Multilingual or experience selling into international markets
Why Speechify SIMBA
  • Sell a product that genuinely impresses prospects — sub-second latency and 71+ languages speaks for itself
  • High ownership role with direct input on GTM strategy and positioning
  • Work alongside a team that stays embedded with customers, so you're never selling something that doesn't deliver
  • Competitive base + commission, equity, and benefits
  • Fast-moving startup environment where your wins have outsized impact

What You'll Do
  • Lead the design, architecture, and development of native Windows desktop applications using Windows App SDK, WinUI (or related UI frameworks), C#, XAML, and — when needed — C++.
  • Define and enforce best-practices for Windows desktop development across the codebase: code architecture, performance, memory usage, responsive UI, cross-version compatibility (Windows 10/11+), and maintainability.
